text.description_html:
Mounting Bracket for Stop Mounted Coordinator, Don-Jo 2050

Don-Jo's 2050 mounting bracket is for use with stop mounted hardware with stop widths that are over 2-1/2". Ready to paint aluminum finish. Includes 4 ea. #10-32 x 1-1/2" machine screws for installation into metal stop.

*Sold Individually
